page: Microsoft Azure D32plds_v6 is an ARM64 virtual machine powered by a Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 3.4 GHz with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, translating to a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled, consisting of a 1890 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores falling into the top 25% tier. Memory performance is highly competitive; the instance achieves top-tier status in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 450.77 GB/sec and Passmark memory tests. Database operations also rank in the top 10% tier. However, single-core performance and large-model LLM inference, such as prompt processing for 70B models, are relatively weaker.

Given its ARM64 architecture and dedicated vCPU allocation, the D32plds_v6 offers a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded, compute-bound workloads that do not require high memory-per-core ratios. The combination of fast local NVMe storage and high database benchmark scores makes it highly suitable for database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
